title: rubus fruticosus var. rhamnifolius
intro: Rubus fruticosus var. rhamnifolius, commonly known as Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan black raspberry, is a variety of the black raspberry plant native to the Himalayan region. It is a type of bramble fruit that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in preventing cancer, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Rubus fruticosus var. rhamnifolius include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
